roles.purpose: Observe, reconcile, prioritize, route, lease, and keep the company moving without becoming the sole technical gate.
Own the single canonical implementation stream for one bounded Work Unit.
Map code, dependencies, regressions, and likely impact using read-mostly access.
Design adversarial, regression, and acceptance tests independent of implementation convenience.
Diagnose CI/runtime failures from evidence before remediation is attempted.
Review the full exact-head candidate against acceptance, correctness, security, and compatibility requirements.
Evaluate privilege, secrets, trust boundaries, injection, privacy, and abuse paths.
Reproduce and fix deterministic CI failures on the existing canonical branch without scope expansion.
Merge only after verifying expected head, required green CI, and current exact-head gate.
